about_the_game:
Return to your grandpa’s farm and restore it to its former glory in Chiklet's Human Products that uniquely blends farming, automation, and survival. Begin your journey on a wild, overgrown island with only a few coins and the guidance of your grandpa’s old buddy, Hacklet. As you explore, capture and harvest wild humans of all rarities, transforming them into a myriad of bizarre recipes that challenge conventional farming.

Rebuild your grandpa’s old friends’ shops and defy the oppressive rule of a new king who values human life above all else. But be warned—the islands are rife with danger. Ferocious monsters lurk around every corner, on both land and water, ready to strike without hesitation. Equip yourself with a formidable arsenal of cutting-edge tools and weapons to survive.

Inspired by the satirical edge of George Orwell’s Animal Farm, Chiklet's Human Products immerses you in a conflicted world where the worth of human life is reimagined with a darkly humorous twist. Expand your farm by manually hunting and gathering resources, then gradually automate your operations for maximum profit. Craft and sell an array of exotic recipes—from Human Tikka Masala to Thigh Burgers and Finger Pizza—while carefully balancing your farm’s reputation against the risk of notoriety.

Key Features:

Build, upgrade, and expand your farm to achieve unparalleled profits. Transition from manual labor to automated processes, and master the art of crafting unique human-based recipes.

Encounter not only feeble, wild humans but also formidable monsters as you venture into uncharted territories. Hone your combat skills and strategically upgrade your arsenal to overcome these threats.

Meet a colorful cast of characters who offer diverse quests—from treasure hunts to the capture of rare humans, monsters, and fish. Equip your shovel, fishing rod, and weapons, and embark on daring adventures across the wildest islands.

Will you revive your grandpa’s legacy and defy the tyranny of a king obsessed with human life, or will the challenges of the islands prove too daunting? The choice is yours in this quirky, darkly humorous farming adventure!

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts humans being chopped by animals in a comical, satirical way.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX760 | AMD Radeon 7950
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommend installing Sandrock on SSD ; Minimum System Requirements might change in the future

  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K | AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX1060 | AMD Radeon RX 580

short_description: This is a farming game, but animals farm human products. Step into the shoes of Chiklet, heir to your grandfather’s eccentric farm. Hunt, craft, sell, and expand your domain as you explore adventurous islands and meet an unforgettable cast of characters.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
